introHtml: Lat Apparel pullovers offer a modern, athletic fit that stands out in the promotional market. Made from heavyweight cotton-poly blends, they hold up to frequent washing and screen printing without shrinking. Safety managers and HR directors choose these pullovers for employee rewards and company events because the fabric provides a premium feel that recipients actually wear. Decorating with your logo works well on the left chest or full back using screen printing or embroidery. The charcoal heather color hides stains and keeps a professional look shift after shift.
